title: Achieving Goals
transcript: Life is a lot like chess, you know? Sometimes we get so fixated on what our final goal is that we forget that all that we can do right here, right now is to just take that first step. It can be so easy to get overwhelmed by the distance between where you are and where your goal is. And it is very easy to get distracted by other things thinking that these are more important. Not only that, very often when you start making some progress, you will realize that that progress is slowing down and maybe again you will get distracted and worried and you will lose your focus and do something else. But as long as you have taken those first steps, you will have still made progress. As long as you don't stop moving, you're just going to get closer and closer until eventually you are going to reach that goal. But here's the part that not enough people talk about. Once you reach your goal, you are going to realize that you don't have one anymore. And like that, it's very easy for people to get lost and complacent with whatever goal they achieved and think that that's enough, that's all they needed. But the cool thing about goals, tasks, and dreams is that whenever you achieve one, you can always move on to the next one.
